title: Office Life and Job Roles
ringkas: Divisi, jabatan, tugas harian, dan jadwal kerja
goals: menjelaskan **tugas harian** memakai simple present dan kata keterangan frekuensi
membedakan simple present (rutinitas) dan present continuous (sedang dikerjakan)
menyebut **jadwal kerja**, jam kerja, dan fasilitas kantor
bertanya dan menjawab tentang pekerjaan: [[What do you do?]], [[What does your job involve?]]
membicarakan beban kerja dan prioritas dengan sopan

lesson.text: Setiap kantor punya **divisi**, **jabatan**, dan **rutinitas**. Agar bisa bekerja sama, kamu perlu tahu cara menyebut siapa mengerjakan apa. Di unit ini kamu belajar kosakata kantor dan cara menjelaskan pekerjaanmu dengan jelas.

items.ex: The assistant books the meeting room.
My workload is heavy this week.
This report is a top priority.
The meeting room is on the second floor.

lesson.title: Letak kata keterangan frekuensi
lesson.text: Kata seperti [[always]], [[usually]], [[often]], [[sometimes]], [[never]] diletakkan **sebelum kata kerja utama** tetapi **setelah to be**: [[She usually arrives early.]] / [[She is usually early.]]

lesson.title: 4. Present continuous untuk pekerjaan saat ini
table: [[We're working on a new product this month.]]

lesson.title: 5. Bertanya tentang pekerjaan
table: [[It involves checking invoices and preparing reports.]]
[[I work from 8 to 5, Monday to Friday.]]
[[How many people are in your team?]]

lesson.title: Menjelaskan pekerjaan dengan jelas
lesson.text: Pakai pola **jabatan + divisi + tugas utama**: [[I'm a marketing officer. I plan social media campaigns and write reports.]] Gunakan kata kerja aktif seperti [[manage]], [[prepare]], [[check]], [[organise]], [[support]].

items: Divisi: HR, Finance, Marketing, Sales, IT, Operations, Customer Service.
Sedang dikerjakan: **present continuous** ([[I'm preparing a report.]]).
Tanya: [[What do you do?]] / [[Who do you report to?]] / [[What does your job involve?]]
Beban kerja: sebut **prioritas** dan **tenggat** dengan sopan.

read.id:
Tim pemasaran mulai bekerja pukul 08.30. Setiap Senin pukul 09.00, ketua tim, Pak Adi, mengadakan rapat singkat untuk meninjau hasil minggu lalu dan menetapkan prioritas minggu baru.
Setelah itu, Dina mengerjakan konten media sosial, Bayu menyiapkan laporan untuk klien, dan Sari menghubungi desainer tentang brosur baru. Pukul 12.00, semua orang istirahat makan siang selama satu jam. Pada hari Jumat, tim pulang lebih awal pukul 16.30.

qs.q: What time does the marketing team start work?

qs.exp: Teks: "review last week's results and set priorities".
options: They review results and set priorities.
They have lunch together and talk about food.
They go home early and rest for the day.
They meet clients at a restaurant downtown.
qs.q: What happens at the Monday meeting?
What time does the team leave on Fridays?

read.text:
The marketing team starts work at 8.30 a.m. Every Monday at 9.00, the team leader, Mr. Adi, holds a short meeting to review last week's results and set priorities for the new week.
After that, Dina works on social media content, Bayu prepares reports for clients, and Sari contacts designers about new brochures. At 12.00, everyone takes a one-hour lunch break. On Fridays, the team leaves earlier at 4.30 p.m.
read.title: A Day in the Marketing Department

read.id:
Di PT Sinar Abadi, setiap departemen memiliki peran yang jelas. Departemen SDM merekrut karyawan baru dan mengelola gaji mereka. Departemen keuangan membayar pemasok dan menyusun anggaran tahunan. Departemen TI memperbaiki masalah komputer dan menjaga keamanan data perusahaan.
Sementara itu, tim layanan pelanggan menjawab pertanyaan pelanggan melalui telepon dan email. Jika kamu punya masalah dengan laptopmu, hubungi TI. Jika slip gajimu salah, bicaralah dengan SDM.

qs.q: Who should you talk to about an incorrect payslip?

read.text:
At PT Sinar Abadi, each department has a clear role. The HR department recruits new employees and manages their salaries. The finance department pays suppliers and prepares the annual budget. The IT department fixes computer problems and keeps company data safe.
Meanwhile, the customer service team answers questions from customers by phone and email. If you have a problem with your laptop, contact IT. If your payslip is incorrect, speak to HR.

Aku bekerja di departemen keuangan. Hariku biasanya mulai pukul sembilan, dan aku memeriksa email lebih dulu. Tim kami mengadakan rapat singkat setiap pagi untuk membahas rencana hari itu.
Saat ini, aku sedang menyiapkan laporan bulanan, dan rekanku Anton sedang menelepon pemasok. Manajer sedang bertemu klien di Ruang 3, jadi tolong jangan ganggu dia. Kami biasanya selesai kerja pukul lima, tetapi minggu ini kami tinggal lebih lama karena audit akan datang.

read.text:
I work in the finance department. My day usually starts at nine, and I check emails first. Our team has a short meeting every morning to discuss the plans for the day.
Right now, I am preparing the monthly report, and my colleague Anton is calling a supplier. The manager is meeting a client in Room 3, so please do not disturb her. We normally finish work at five, but this week we are staying later because the audit is coming.
